e.title: **一份**锁死的农业参数保险基准**：12,000 个保单—季节情景、**五个气候风险体制、**三个种子全写明**：Zenodo 记录 `10.5281/zenodo.22701753`（AgriParam-Chain v1.0）——**⭐ 本次实测**：**CSV **21 列 × **12,000 行****（**切分恰好 **8,400／1,800／1,800**，**体制恰好 **3,600／2,640／2,160／1,800／1,800****）**；**⭐ 它自带一份**「**锁定稿件结果**」**文件**（**12 行，**每行给出**稿件位置**）**；**⭐ 并逐字规定**「**If the benchmark-generation procedure is changed, the revised package should be released as a new repository version rather than silently replacing v1.0**」**；**⚠️ 而 Zenodo 上的**描述字段为空、**创建者名登记为 **`cursor`****
e.title_en: A frozen agricultural parametric-insurance benchmark of twelve thousand policy-season scenarios across five climate-risk regimes, shipping its own locked manuscript results file with locations into the paper, a construction protocol with three seeds, a checksum manifest and a rule that any change to the generation procedure must be released as a new version rather than silently replacing the frozen one.
e.title_hk: **一份**鎖死的農業參數保險基準**：12,000 個保單—季節情景、**五個氣候風險體制、**三個種子全寫明**：Zenodo 記錄 `10.5281/zenodo.22701753`（AgriParam-Chain v1.0）——**⭐ 本次實測**：**CSV **21 列 × **12,000 行****（**切分恰好 **8,400／1,800／1,800**，**體制恰好 **3,600／2,640／2,160／1,800／1,800****）**；**⭐ 它自帶一份**「**鎖定稿件結果**」**檔案**（**12 行，**每行給出**稿件位置**）**；**⭐ 並逐字規定**「**If the benchmark-generation procedure is changed, the revised package should be released as a new repository version rather than silently replacing v1.0**」**；**⚠️ 而 Zenodo 上的**描述欄位為空、**創建者名登記為 **`cursor`****
e.summary: **agriparam-chain**（Zenodo 记录 **`10.5281/zenodo.22701753`**，**概念 DOI **`10.5281/zenodo.22701752`****，**逐字标题含**「**AgriParam-Chain: Explainable Multimodal AI with Dynamic Basis-Risk Optimization for Parametric Crop Insurance and Oracle-Verified Blockchain Smart-Contract Payouts**」**）**是一份**面向农业参数保险的受控多模态基准包****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**许可 **CC-BY-4.0**、**创建 **2026-09-11**、**类型为 dataset**、**单一文件包 **`AgriParamChain_Zenodo_Package_v1.0.zip`（**2,626,244 字节**）**，**包内实测 **11 个文件**（**基准 CSV ＋ **同内容 xlsx ＋ **数据切分 ＋ **锁定结果 ＋ **变量字典 ＋ **README ＋ **构造协议 ＋ **元数据模板 ＋ **SHA256 清单 ＋ **生成代码 ＋ **依赖清单**）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**登记处纪律：锁住版本**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **基准被**冻结**，**且逐字规定改动须另发新版**；**② **自带**锁定稿件结果**文件**（**12 行指标，**逐行标注**稿件位置**）**；**③ **构造协议把**每个权重与三个种子**都写出来**；**④ **⚠️ 而**登记处上的描述字段**是空的**。**⚠️ 本次**未复算其任何模型指标**。
e.summary_hk: **agriparam-chain**（Zenodo 記錄 **`10.5281/zenodo.22701753`**，**概念 DOI **`10.5281/zenodo.22701752`****，**逐字標題含**「**AgriParam-Chain: Explainable Multimodal AI with Dynamic Basis-Risk Optimization for Parametric Crop Insurance and Oracle-Verified Blockchain Smart-Contract Payouts**」**）**是一份**面向農業參數保險的受控多模態基準包****——**⭐ 本次實測**：**許可 **CC-BY-4.0**、**建立 **2026-09-11**、**類型為 dataset**、**單一檔案包 **`AgriParamChain_Zenodo_Package_v1.0.zip`（**2,626,244 位元組**）**，**包內實測 **11 個檔案**（**基準 CSV ＋** 同內容 xlsx ＋** 資料切分 ＋** 鎖定結果 ＋** 變數字典 ＋** README ＋** 構造協議 ＋** 元資料模板 ＋** SHA256 清單 ＋** 生成代碼 ＋** 依賴清單**）**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**登記處紀律：鎖住版本**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **基準被**凍結**，**且逐字規定改動須另發新版**；**② **自帶**鎖定稿件結果**檔案**（**12 行指標，**逐行標註**稿件位置**）**；**③ **構造協議把**每個權重與三個種子**都寫出來**；**④ **⚠️ 而**登記處上的描述欄位**是空的**。**⚠️ 本次**未複算其任何模型指標**。
e.summary_en: The Zenodo record agriparam-chain, held under a version DOI with a separate concept DOI, **is a controlled multimodal benchmark package for agricultural parametric insurance**, titled as explainable multimodal artificial intelligence with dynamic basis-risk optimization for parametric crop insurance and oracle-verified blockchain smart-contract payouts. **Measured this round**: **licensed under a Creative Commons attribution licence**, **created 2026-09-11**, **registered as a dataset**, with a single package file of about 2.6 megabytes containing **eleven files** that were measured directly: the benchmark table, an identical workbook copy, the frozen data splits, the locked manuscript results, a variable dictionary, a readme, a scenario-construction protocol, a metadata template, a checksum manifest, the generation code and a dependency list. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry discipline, here freezing a version**, and **four things are worth reading: the benchmark is frozen with a written rule that any change to the generation procedure must be released as a new version rather than silently replacing it; the package ships its own locked manuscript results file with twelve metric rows each naming its location in the paper; the construction protocol writes out every response weight and all three random seeds; and the registry description field itself is empty**. **None of the model metrics were recomputed this round.**
e.body:
**agriparam-chain**（Zenodo 记录 **`10.5281/zenodo.22701753`**，**概念 DOI **`10.5281/zenodo.22701752`****）**是一份**面向农业参数保险的受控多模态基准包****——**逐字标题为**「**AgriParam-Chain: Explainable Multimodal AI with Dynamic Basis-Risk Optimization for Parametric Crop Insurance and Oracle-Verified Blockchain Smart-Contract Payouts**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-09-11**、**类型 dataset**、**许可 **CC-BY-4.0**、**单一文件 **`AgriParamChain_Zenodo_Package_v1.0.zip`（**2,626,244 字节**）**；**⭐ 本次**下载并解包**后实测包内 **11 个文件**；**⚠️ 而 Zenodo 登记页上的**描述字段长度为 0****（**即**这一条记录**没有任何描述**）**，**创建者字段逐字登记为 **`cursor`****。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**登记处纪律：锁住版本**」**。

**可核实信息（均 Zenodo API 元数据、包内文件与本次直接计数实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 基准被**冻结**，**且改动规则被逐字写明****——**README 逐字**：**「**Version 1.0 is intended to remain frozen for the associated manuscript. **If the benchmark-generation procedure is changed, the revised package should be released as a new repository version rather than silently replacing v1.0.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**「**冻结**」**不是**一句口头承诺**，**而是**一条**操作规程**（**改动 → **另发版本**，**而**不是**悄悄覆盖**）**——**⭐ 这与本站第 350 轮「**来源与生成物**」、第 352 轮「**登记与出处**」同向**：**版本号**是**可被引用的锚点**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它自带一份**「**锁定稿件结果**」**文件****——**实测** `AgriParamChain_Locked_Manuscript_Results.csv` **共 **12 行**、**5 列逐字为** `domain`／`metric`／`configuration`／`locked_value`／`manuscript_location`**；**⭐ 本次读到的前五行逐字为**：**Predictive Ｒ²／**AgriParam-Chain ensemble／**0.985／**Table 6 / Abstract / Conclusion；**Predictive RMSE／**0.0277；**Predictive MAE／**0.0221；**Predictive F1／**0.979；**Predictive AUROC／**0.999**（**⭐ 均为同一处稿件位置**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一列** `manuscript_location` **尤其值得抄**：**⭐ 即**每个数**都指回**它在论文里的位置**——**⭐ 这与本站第 340 轮「**把每个数从哪来写在旁边**」同向**，**而**这里更进一步**：**数据包里**预先记下了**稿件里的数**，**以便日后核对**。**⚠️ 本词条如实指出**：**⭐ 这些指标**（**R² **0.985**、**AUROC **0.999**）是在**一份合成基准上**取得的**，**⭐ 而**该基准的**构造协议自己写明**它**不是**实地试验、**不是**农户层组合、**也不是**保险公司的生产部署**（**见下第 ③ 点**）**——**⭐ 故**这些数字**不得**当作任何真实农险的预测能力**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 构造协议把**响应权重、**交互项、**边界与三个种子**全部写出****——**实测** `Scenario_Construction_Protocol.md` **逐字给出**：**体制分配固定为** normal **3,600**／drought **2,640**／heat **2,160**／excess rainfall **1,800**／compound drought-heat **1,800****；**⭐ 相对系数层级逐字为**降雨亏缺 **0.224**、**高温暴露 **0.186**、**土壤湿度胁迫 **0.163**、**植被胁迫 **0.149**、**干期强度 **0.108**、**物候敏感性 **0.095**、**参考产量情境 **0.075**、**过量降雨胁迫 **0.100****；**交互项逐字为**干旱—高温耦合、**物候—高温耦合、**物候—降雨耦合、**过量降雨／根区耦合**；**⭐ 严重损失定义逐字为** `yield_loss_severity >= 0.20`**；**⭐ 三个种子逐字为** primary **20260911**、**residual-loss **123**、**split **20260912****；**⭐ 并逐字把它们各自的角色分开**（**主种子／**残差种子／**切分种子**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得抄**：**⭐ 即**「**合成数据**」**也可以**完全可复述**——**⭐ 只要**把权重、**交互与种子**写出来**；**⭐ 而**作者**同时**逐字限定范围**「**It does not claim newly collected field measurements or a live insurer deployment.**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ **本次实测**核对了它自述的几处计数**——**⭐ 即**这一条**不只是转述**：**⭐ 基准 CSV 实测 **21 列 × **12,000 行****；**切分实测**恰好 **train 8,400／validation 1,800／test 1,800****；**风险体制实测**恰好 **3,600／2,640／2,160／1,800／1,800****——**⭐ 与 README 与协议**逐字所述一致**；**⭐ 另有** `SHA256SUMS.txt` **对 **10 个文件**给出校验和**（**⭐ 本次读到前 10 行**）**。**⭐ 即**「**12,000 个情景**」这一自述**是**可以被数出来的**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 变量字典与边界被写明**——**实测** `AgriParamChain_Variable_Dictionary.csv` **给出**变量名、**描述、**类型、**单位或范围、**角色与构造方式**；**⭐ 本次读到的表头逐字为** `variable_name`／`description`／`data_type`／`unit_or_range`／`role`／`construction`**，**并逐字说明**所有归一化胁迫指数**被限制在 **0 至 1****；**⭐ 多模态输入逐字含**降雨异常、**亏缺、**过量与干期强度；**平均温度与高温暴露；**根区土壤湿度与湿度胁迫；**NDVI／**EVI 与植被胁迫；**物候阶段与物候敏感性；**参考产量**。**⭐ 本词条认为**变量字典带「**构造**」一列**是实用之处**：**⭐ 即**每个变量**是怎么算出来的**，**写在数据旁边**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 一处**登记处的空白**（本次实测）**——**⭐ Zenodo 记录的**描述字段为空**（**长度 0**）**，**而**包内 `README.md`（**2,919 字节**）**与** `Zenodo_Metadata_Template.txt`（**1,438 字节**）**都提供了**可粘贴的描述与元数据模板**；**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得单独记**：**⭐ 即**包里**连「**该怎么填登记处**」**都准备好了**，**而**登记处**本身**仍是空的**——**⭐ 本词条**如实记录这个落差**，**不推测原因**（**⭐ 例如**是否与登记流程有关**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 两处**模板占位符未被替换**（本次实测）**——**README 的建议「**数据可得性声明**」**逐字含** `**[insert final repository DOI/URL]**`**，**建议引用格式**逐字含** `**Repository DOI: [insert DOI after publication]**`**——**⭐ 即**这两处**仍是占位符**，**而**该记录**已经有 DOI**；**⭐ 本词条**如实记录**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 生成代码与依赖被写明，**且极小****——**实测** `benchmark_generation_code.py`（**6,923 字节**）**与** `requirements.txt`（**12 字节，**逐字 `numpy>=1.24`**）**——**⭐ 即**只要一个依赖**即可重建**；**⭐ 这与第 ③ 点的种子说明合起来**，**构成**一条**完整的复现路径**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 数据使用与文献依据被写明**——**逐字**：**「**No personally identifiable information, confidential farmer records, clinical information, or proprietary insurance-policy records are included.**」**；**⭐ 并列出五篇文献依据**（**含期刊与 DOI**，**逐字含** Wijesena & Pradhan (2026) **与** Nguyen et al. (2025) **等**）**，**并逐字说明**「**These publications motivate the benchmark dimensions and evaluation scope; the repository’s controlled parameterization is documented above for reproducibility.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**把「**文献启发**」与「**本地参数化**」分开说明**是值得抄的**：**⭐ 即**不把**参照文献**说成**方法来源的背书**。**⭐⭐ ⑩ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[agrisky-ai]]、**[[fasal-pramaan-crop-claims]] 覆盖农业保险 AI 与作物理赔**，**[[parametric-risk-toolkit]]、**[[geo-catastrophe-pricing]]、**[[storm-parametric-corroboration]]、**[[ballast-parametric-cover]] 覆盖参数化风险与参数触发**，**[[usda-rma]]、**[[china-agrore]]、**[[moa-data]]、**[[earth-engine]] 覆盖农业与遥感数据源**，**[[synthetic-resdac-claims]] 覆盖合成数据与「**单一族群逐年滚动**」的做法**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一份**合成农险基准：**冻结版本 ＋ **锁定稿件结果 ＋ **权重与种子全写明 ＋ **自查计数可核对**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[agrisky-ai]]、[[parametric-risk-toolkit]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的五点**：**① **合成基准要**冻结**，**并写明**改动即另发版本**；**② **把稿件里用到的指标**锁进一份文件**，**并标注**它在论文中的位置**；**③ **生成过程的**权重、**交互与种子**全部写出**；**④ **自查计数**（**行数、**切分比例、**体制分布**）**应与自述一致**；**⑤ **包里可以准备登记处元数据模板**，**但**登记处本身别留空**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有复算该基准上的任何模型指标****（**未训练任何模型、**未运行其生成代码、**未验证锁定结果文件里的 **R²／RMSE／MAE／F1／AUROC** 能否被复现**），**故**不主张**其任何性能数字**；**⭐ 并如实指出**：**这些数字取自**合成基准**，**而**基准的协议**自己写明它**不是**实地测量、**不是**农户层组合、**也不是**生产部署**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 本次**只读了包内的文档与表头**，**未读** `benchmark_generation_code.py` **的正文逻辑**（**⭐ 未审代码是否正确实现协议**）**，**也未核对** `SHA256SUMS.txt` **是否与实际文件一致**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**其**文献依据**是否**真实存在且与所述一致**（**⭐ 本次**未访问任何 DOI**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实** xlsx **与 CSV 是否内容一致**（**⭐ 实测两者体量不同、**本词条只并列**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**作者身份**：**⭐ Zenodo 的**创建者字段逐字为 **`cursor`****（**⭐ 本词条**不推测其为人名、**机构名或工具名**）**；**⭐ 并如实指出**：**该记录**没有描述、**没有关键词、**也没有相关标识**，**故**无法从登记处本身判断其作者与来源**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**该记录与**任何稿件**是否已发表或预印**（**⭐ 标题声称有对应手稿，**但**本次**未查证**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实**区块链与「**oracle 验证**」**在包内是否有实现**（**⭐ 实测包内**只有基准数据、**文档与生成代码**，**未见合约代码**）**——**⭐ 本词条**据此只描述**数据与协议**，**不主张**其区块链部分已被实现**。**⑧ ⚠️ **许可**为** CC-BY-4.0**（**须署名**）**；**⭐ 而**署名对象**因创建者字段为 `cursor` **而**不明确**——**⭐ 本词条**如实指出这一点**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目的**窗口状况**：**创建于 **2026-09-11**（**在解冻窗口之内**）**，**⭐ 无需窗口例外说明**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该基准为合成数据**，**其结论**不得**用于任何真实参数保险的触发设计、**定价或赔付判断**。
e.body_hk:
**agriparam-chain**（Zenodo 記錄 **`10.5281/zenodo.22701753`**，**概念 DOI **`10.5281/zenodo.22701752`****）**是一份**面向農業參數保險的受控多模態基準包****——**逐字標題為**「**AgriParam-Chain: Explainable Multimodal AI with Dynamic Basis-Risk Optimization for Parametric Crop Insurance and Oracle-Verified Blockchain Smart-Contract Payouts**」**。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-09-11**、**類型 dataset**、**許可 CC-BY-4.0**、**單一檔案 **`AgriParamChain_Zenodo_Package_v1.0.zip`（**2,626,244 位元組**）**；**⭐ 本次**下載並解包**後實測包內 **11 個檔案**；**⚠️ 而 Zenodo 登記頁上的**描述欄位長度為 0****，**創建者欄位逐字登記為 **`cursor`****。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**登記處紀律：鎖住版本**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 Zenodo API 元資料、包內檔案與本次直接計數實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 基準被**凍結**，**且改動規則逐字寫明****——**逐字**「**Version 1.0 is intended to remain frozen for the associated manuscript. If the benchmark-generation procedure is changed, the revised package should be released as a new repository version rather than silently replacing v1.0.**」**——**⭐ 即**「**凍結**」**不是口頭承諾**，**而是**一條操作規程**：**改動要另發版本**，**不是悄悄覆蓋**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 自帶一份**「**鎖定稿件結果**」**檔案****——**實測** `AgriParamChain_Locked_Manuscript_Results.csv` **共 **12 行**、**5 列逐字為** The Zenodo record agriparam-chain, held under a version DOI with a separate concept DOI, **is a controlled multimodal benchmark package for agricultural parametric insurance**, titled as explainable multimodal artificial intelligence with dynamic basis-risk optimization for parametric crop insurance and oracle-verified blockchain smart-contract payouts. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-09-11**, **registered as a dataset**, **licensed under a Creative Commons attribution licence**, with a single package file of about two point six megabytes, and **eleven files inside that package were listed directly this round**. **⚠️ The registry description field is empty**, with a length of zero, and the creator field is registered verbatim as a single word that this entry does not interpret as a person, an institution or a tool. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry discipline, here freezing a version.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata, the package contents and direct counting**: **first, the benchmark is frozen and the rule for changing it is written down verbatim**: version 1.0 is intended to remain frozen for the associated manuscript, and if the benchmark-generation procedure is changed the revised package should be released as a new repository version rather than silently replacing version 1.0. **A freeze is therefore an operating rule rather than a promise: a change produces a new version instead of quietly overwriting the old one.** **Second, the package ships its own locked manuscript results file**: measured as twelve rows with five columns named for the domain, the metric, the configuration, the locked value and the manuscript location, with the first five rows recording an R-squared of about zero point nine eight five, a root mean squared error of about zero point zero two eight, a mean absolute error of about zero point zero two two, an F1 of about zero point nine eight and an area under the curve of about zero point nine nine nine, each pointing at the same table, abstract and conclusion location. **Recording the numbers used in the manuscript inside the data package, each with a pointer to where it appears, is one step beyond writing down where each number came from, because it lets a later check compare the paper against the package.** **This entry states plainly that these figures come from a synthetic benchmark and that the benchmark protocol itself says it is not newly collected field measurement, not a farmer-level portfolio and not a live insurer deployment, so the figures must not be read as predictive ability on any real agricultural insurance book.** **Third, the construction protocol writes out the weights, interactions and all three seeds**: the regime allocation is fixed at thirty-six hundred normal, twenty-six hundred and forty drought, twenty-one hundred and sixty heat, eighteen hundred excess rainfall and eighteen hundred compound drought-heat scenarios; the relative coefficient hierarchy is stated as rainfall deficit zero point two two four, heat exposure zero point one eight six, soil-moisture stress zero point one six three, vegetation stress zero point one four nine, dry-spell intensity zero point one zero eight, phenological sensitivity zero point zero nine five, reference-yield context zero point zero seven five and excess-rainfall stress zero point one zero zero; interaction terms cover drought-heat, phenology-heat, phenology-rainfall and excess-rainfall with root-zone coupling; a severe-loss label is assigned at a yield-loss severity of at least zero point two; and three seeds are given with distinct roles, one primary, one for residual loss and one for splitting. **The protocol also states verbatim that the package does not claim newly collected field measurements or a live insurer deployment, which is what makes synthetic data fully restatable without overclaiming.** **Fourth, several of the package own counts were checked directly this round**: the benchmark table has twenty-one columns and exactly twelve thousand rows; the splits are exactly eight thousand four hundred training, one thousand eight hundred validation and one thousand eight hundred test; the risk regimes are exactly the five counts claimed; and a checksum manifest covers ten files. **A claim of twelve thousand scenarios can therefore simply be counted.** **Fifth, the variable dictionary and its bounds are given**: the measured column headers are the variable name, description, data type, unit or range, role and construction, with a statement that all normalised stress indices are bounded between zero and one, and multimodal inputs covering rainfall anomaly, deficit, excess and dry-spell intensity, mean temperature and heat exposure, root-zone soil moisture, two vegetation indices with a stress descriptor, phenological stage and sensitivity, and a reference yield. **The construction column is the practical part, because each variable carries how it was computed.** **Sixth, one blank in the registry was measured**: the description field is empty, while the package contains both a readme and a metadata template, so the package even prepares what should be pasted into the registry while the registry itself remains unfilled; **this entry records the gap without speculating about its cause**. **Seventh, two template placeholders were left unreplaced**: the suggested data-availability statement still contains a placeholder for the final repository identifier, and the suggested citation still contains a placeholder for the DOI to be inserted after publication, even though the record already has a DOI. **Eighth, the generation code and dependencies are minimal**: a single generation script of about seven kilobytes and a dependency file whose entire content is one numeric library floor, so the benchmark can be reconstructed with one dependency. **Ninth, the data-use note and literature basis are stated**: no personally identifiable information, confidential farm records, clinical information or proprietary policy records are included, and five references are listed with journals and identifiers, followed by the statement that those publications motivate the benchmark dimensions and evaluation scope while the controlled parameterisation is documented locally for reproducibility. **Motivation from the literature is therefore kept separate from local parameterisation rather than presented as endorsement.** **Tenth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover agricultural insurance artificial intelligence and crop claims, parametric risk and trigger tooling, agricultural and remote-sensing data sources and a synthetic claims dataset built by rolling one cohort forward, **while this entry supplies a synthetic agricultural benchmark with a frozen version, a locked manuscript results file, fully stated weights and seeds, and self-declared counts that can be counted. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled agricultural insurance entry and the pooled parametric risk toolkit**; **five practices transfer directly: freeze a synthetic benchmark and state that any change means a new version; lock the numbers used in the paper into a file with their locations; write out the weights, interactions and seeds of the generation process; make self-declared counts checkable and check them; and prepare registry metadata in the package while making sure the registry itself is not left empty**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no model metric from this benchmark was recomputed** — no model trained, the generation code not run, and the locked values not checked against any reproduction — **so none of the reported performance figures is claimed**, and **this entry states plainly that they come from a synthetic benchmark whose own protocol disclaims field measurement, farmer-level portfolios and production deployment**. **Second, only the package documents and table headers were read**: the generation code body was not read and therefore no judgement is offered on whether the code implements the protocol, nor was the checksum manifest verified against the files; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the five cited references were not verified to exist as described**, no identifier having been visited. **Fourth, whether the workbook copy matches the comma-separated benchmark was not verified**, only their differing sizes being recorded. **Fifth, the author identity was not verified**: the registry creator field holds a single word that this entry declines to interpret, and the record has no description, no keywords and no related identifiers, so authorship cannot be established from the registry alone. **Sixth, whether any manuscript associated with this package has been published or posted was not verified.** **Seventh, whether the blockchain and oracle-verification part is implemented anywhere in the package was not verified**; the measured package contains only benchmark data, documents and generation code with no contract code, **so this entry describes only the data and protocol and does not claim the blockchain part exists**. **Eighth, the licence is a Creative Commons attribution licence, and this entry notes that the attribution target is unclear because the creator field is not a name. Ninth, on the window: the record was created 2026-09-11, inside the thaw window, so there is no window exception to declare. Tenth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that the benchmark is synthetic and must not be used for trigger design, pricing or payout decisions on any real parametric insurance programme.**
